instruction: Update the system hostname by editing both /etc/hostname and /etc/hosts for a permanent change.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because permanently changing the system hostname requires root privileges to edit /etc/hostname and /etc/hosts. While agents might be able to read these files, they cannot modify system configuration files without elevated permissions that are restricted in the OSWorld sandbox environment.
